# International Football Stats

> A comprehensive database of international football match results dating back to 1872.

## What's Here
- 300+ national and non-FIFA teams including historical entities like Soviet Union, Czechoslovakia, and Yugoslavia
- 200+ tournaments: World Cup, Euros, Copa América, African Cup of Nations, Asian Games, friendlies, and more
- Match results with scores, dates, cities, and host countries
- ELO ratings calculated from historical match results
- Head-to-head comparisons between any two teams
- Goal scorers and shootout data
- Decade-by-decade dominance rankings

## Key Pages
- /teams — Browse all teams
- /teams/{name} — Team detail with full match history and stats
- /tournaments — Browse all tournaments
- /tournaments/{name} — Tournament detail with seasons and results
- /tournaments/{name}/season/{year} — Season standings and matches
- /head-to-head — Compare any two teams head-to-head
- /elo-ranking — Current ELO world rankings with historical charts
- /decade-leaders — Top teams by decade based on ELO ratings
- /house-keeping — Teams mapped to countries and flags

## API
The site exposes a REST API at /api/proxy/ with endpoints for teams, tournaments, matches, rankings, and filters. An MCP server is also available at futebol-mcp.orbisplace.co.uk.

## Data Coverage
Matches from 1872 to present day. Includes FIFA and non-FIFA teams, CONIFA World Cup, regional competitions, youth tournaments, and historical qualifiers.
